product_one_liner.value: PolyAI builds voice-and-chat dialog agents for enterprises that resolve complex customer conversations and tasks without escalation.
product_one_liner.notes: The company describes enterprise dialog agents that resolve critical conversations; its documentation describes voice and chat agents.

pricing_page.notes: A public pricing page exists and describes per-minute pricing and plan features.

named_customers.notes: Each named company appears in PolyAI customer case studies.

employee_band.notes: PolyAI reports 250 employees, which falls in the 201-500 band.

hq_location.notes: PolyAI’s headquarters announcement places its HQ at Paddington Central in London, and its company page lists its London office.

founded_year.notes: PolyAI states that it was founded in 2017.

eng_blog.notes: The blog includes an infrastructure post by a Principal Engineer and a voice-latency architecture post by the CTO.

public_docs.notes: PolyAI provides public product documentation, an API reference, and an extensive documentation index.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The careers page and job board list three openings—Staff Product Manager, Senior Marketing Manager, and Senior Account Manager—with no AI, ML, or data-science role title.

model_provider.value: PolyAI's proprietary Raven model family (recommended Raven 3.5); the platform also supports OpenAI and Amazon Bedrock models.
model_provider.notes: Product documentation identifies Raven as PolyAI’s model family and lists the additional model-provider choices.

compliance_certs.notes: PolyAI names SOC 2 Type 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR, and PCI DSS on its security page.

last_funding.notes: The company accounts confirm $20 million in equity funding after January 31, 2026; a funding tracker identifies the raise as a $20 million Series D in April 2026.

raised_18mo.notes: The company accounts report $20 million in equity raised after January 31, 2026; the tracker dates that raise to April 2026, within the 18-month window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The current official careers list has no SDR, BDR, or Account Executive title; the prior Account Executive listing was marked removed on August 20, 2026.

launched_6mo.notes: PolyAI announced Dialog-RSN-1 availability on AWS SageMaker on October 6, 2026, and introduced Wren on September 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: PolyAI announced Sunil Shah’s appointment as CFO on October 8, 2026, within the 12-month window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: A GTM systems job post names Outreach, Gong, HubSpot, and Clay; Salesforce appears in the systems role and PolyAI integration catalog.
